name: ugot-skills
description: UGOT's open skills for Claude Code and Codex: agent mindset gates, reader-first writing, engineering habits.

plugins.name: ugot-mindset
plugins.description: How the agent should think and talk with the user: read the intent, verify before claiming, no silent omission, keep going, brief human answers. 19 skills, 2 agents and automatic prompt/result/stop/bash gates.

plugins.name: ugot-writing
plugins.description: Reader-first writing (mainly Korean): explain for understanding, style editing, applications, songs and lyrics, story craft, short-form ads.

plugins.name: ugot-engineering-habits
plugins.description: Engineering habits for coding agents: build it right the first time, check the latest literature, disclose shortcuts, premortem before claims, use fundamental terms, consult on architecture, separate incident mitigation from the root fix.

plugins.name: ugot-career
plugins.description: Job applications for developers who work with AI coding tools: screen postings, dissect requirements, research the company, build a tailored resume and portfolio story, submit and track.
